verdict.rationale: Month-end close checklists are a fair question for accounting software, but the evidence pack never documents a close checklist or any tracking of reconciliations, accruals, or review sign-offs. The nearest items are adjacent features (bank auto-import, financial reports, accountant user roles), and none of them is a close-management capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
